description: This file contains a SwiftUI extension 'ChannelsSettings' that defines the user interface and behavior for displaying and managing channel settings within an application. It includes various views and UI components such as sidebar lists, detail views, headers, and buttons, along with some lifecycle event handling.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout consisting of sidebar and detail views, with lifecycle event handlers like onAppear, onChange, and onDisappear.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Constructs the sidebar list view showing configured and available channels.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Displays the detailed view for the selected channel or an empty state if none is selected.

methods.name: emptyDetail
methods.description: Provides a placeholder view prompting user to select a channel.

methods.name: channelDetail
methods.description: Renders detailed information and controls for a specific channel.

methods.name: sidebarRow
methods.description: Creates a button representing a channel in the sidebar list, highlighting selection.

methods.name: sidebarSectionHeader
methods.description: Creates section headers within the sidebar list.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Builds header section with channel title, status, last check time, and error indicator.

methods.name: statusBadge
methods.description: Displays a badge indicating channel status with background and foreground colors.
